title: UEW Driver Manifest 3.0.1
description: Canonical transport-asymmetric manifest schema for UEW hardware drivers.

manifest_schema_version.description: Manifest schema version. Must be 3.0.1 for this schema.

shared_quirk_catalog.description: Optional human-readable quirk dictionary referenced by quirk_flags.

version_string.description: Opaque firmware or hardware revision string. Semantic comparison is application-defined.

description.description: Optional local prose describing why the driver is rated at this maturity.

category.description: Stable UEW device category, e.g. brewer, scale, sensor, grinder, analyzer, climate.

identity_surfaces.description: Optional out-of-band identity or ownership surfaces such as NFC, BLE advertisement identity fields, or DIS serials.

device_relationships.description: Optional cross-device relationships such as peer pairing, accessory control, or feature unlock dependencies.

config_parameter_ids.description: Optional shortcut list of manifest-level configuration parameters consumed by this transport.

resources.description: Optional non-streaming resource and file endpoints, typically used for REST-style CRUD, settings, history, and firmware surfaces.

external_inputs.description: Optional workflow-fed external inputs this transport can consume from other devices or orchestration roles.

plugin_id.description: Stable external plugin identity used for provenance, diagnostics, and artifact lifecycle management.

abi_version.description: Host/plugin ABI contract identifier, for example `uew-wasm-driver/v1`.

artifact_sha256.description: Expected SHA-256 digest of the executable driver artifact. Use lowercase hex.

match_priority.description: Higher numbers win when multiple manifests or profiles match the same physical device.

decode.description: Free-form per-channel decode hints when a transport-wide profile is unnecessary.
